items.text:
There is a good game here, it is unique, dark, brutal and fun scavenging space game that does space immersion pretty well. It has been fun for the short 25 hours I have given it which took quiet a bit of Google/YouTube tutorials to learn and but it was worth the time I got out of it so far.

However, as others have mentioned, It needs more time to cook. 

It has many bugs and wonky systems, most of which are somewhat manageable but enough to feel like its still well in early access. 

The art style is great, and it suits the dark and grittiness of space exploration. Feels like you are in The Expanse universe, but the pixel art is a bit too much when it comes to identifying objects as its is a top down game with many different items stacked on and around the same single tiles and it kills the experience a bit. 

I would suggest giving it a proper follow and coming back in a few months to see if major changes/updates are being implemented before I recommend others to buy.

这里有一款好游戏，它是一款独特、黑暗、残酷且有趣的太空拾荒游戏，在太空沉浸感方面做得相当不错。在我投入的短短25小时里，它一直很有趣，这花了我不少时间通过谷歌/YouTube教程来学习，但到目前为止我从中获得的乐趣是值得的。

然而，正如其他人提到的，它还需要更多时间来打磨。

它有很多bug和不稳定的系统，其中大多数还算勉强能应付，但足以让人感觉它仍然处于早期访问阶段。

艺术风格很棒，契合太空探索的黑暗与粗粝感。感觉就像身处《苍穹浩瀚》宇宙中，但像素艺术在识别物体方面有点过于繁琐，因为这是一款俯视视角游戏，许多不同的物品堆叠在同一个格子上及其周围，这有点破坏体验。

我建议先好好关注它，过几个月再回来看看是否有重大改动/更新在实施，然后我才会推荐别人购买。

The game is rough around the edges but it can be incredibly immersive. If you're okay with suffering and are into complex simulations, you'll probably like this. If you need a game to be a polished bug-free experience, this game is not yet for you (despite the 1.0 version).

Lowlights: 
- planned walls function as real walls for pathing. took a long time staring at job cancellations to figure this one out
- no spacewalk hauling animation
- if you become wanted, the game doesn't show you why
- jobs just stall at the hauling phase after pickup sometimes
- extremely tedious to build out your ship, especially if you want coherent tiling
- art style makes it very difficult to discern objects from ship floor or ceiling bin

highlights:
- spaceflight is more fun than I would've thought from the screenshots
- music, atmosphere, backstory/writing, general ambience is great
- can pick and choose which bills to pay
- lots of content (i'm 40 hrs in and haven't made it off of kleg yet)
- good balance of complexity and playability
- good sense of progression and setback
items.text_zh:
这款游戏粗糙得很，但也能带来极强的沉浸感。如果你能忍受痛苦，又喜欢复杂的模拟游戏，你可能会喜欢它。如果你需要一款打磨精良、没有bug的游戏，那这款游戏还不适合你（尽管版本号是1.0）。

不足之处：
- 规划中的墙壁在寻路时被当作真正的墙壁。盯着任务取消看了很久才搞明白这一点
- 没有太空行走搬运的动画
- 如果你被通缉了，游戏不会告诉你原因
- 任务有时在取货后的搬运阶段就卡住了
- 建造飞船极其繁琐，尤其是如果你想要连贯的贴图
- 美术风格让人很难分辨物体和飞船地板或天花板储物箱

亮点：
- 太空飞行比我从截图里想象的有趣得多
- 音乐、氛围、背景故事/文本、整体环境都很棒
- 可以自行选择支付哪些账单
- 内容很多（我已经玩了40小时，还没离开Kleg）
- 复杂度和可玩性之间平衡得很好
- 进步和挫折感都把握得不错

I tried to play this game and I give up.
The choice of graphics looks terrible on a 1440 monitor and its almost impossible for me to actually tell what I'm looking at.
The tutorials explain some things in detail and completely ignore other things, this makes trying to do anything not covered by them an exercise in frustration.
I tried to add some mods to maybe make flying the ship less tedious and learned that the workshop isn't very useful and you have to get some files from GitHub to mod the game files yourself. And even then they probably wont work.
I wish people would stop using this kind of faux retro art style for games, it really does make it vastly harder to play.

Lover of NeoScavanger, got hyped once i saw the 1.0 release on the homepage.

Two hours of raw frustration along with a refund. Absolute atrocious and unreadable UI. Graphics are beyond unappealing, probably should have followed a similar path of art such as Barotruama. Since it's rough to distinguish anything on the screen. Tutorial is non-existant and sends you down a rabbit-hole of confusion. Not to mention the SJW factor showed at your face during character creation which is honestly uneccesary. Plenty other reviews who dig deeper into detail explained here.

Devs most likely chewed off more than they could with this project. Interesting concept, idea and attempt at a great game i will give them that. They had me hooked, line and sinker but redemption is far from sight. Go back to NeoScavenger for the itch, because you won't find it here.

items.text:
I just can't recommend getting it as is i am afraid. 

- The character creation sucks and is lacking features like presets and preset saving, which is not that major anyways, since there is one player model and no matter what it won't look anything like your character regardless of what you chose. It's not just a visual element, i just also dislike the element of randomness in a character creation.

- The UI is awful. In fact, i think this has got to be bar none the worst UI i've ever had to deal with in a video game and i've known the dos era. The information is disorganized, badly presented, implies insane amounts of clicking, the (too) many UI elements have little graphic/logical coherency, it's just a terrible, terrible time dealing with it all. Sure you *can* get used to it. But it was just bad design that stuck throughout EA when it should have been scrapped and redone. No UI/UX person on board and it really shows sadly. Whether it be inventory, character information, terrain or anything else, you'll be trying to enjoy yourself in spite of it the whole time. 

- The game's whole premise is to foster a "theatre of the mind" (dev's words, not mine), but the entire NPC interaction system is just terrible. It's essentially the sims type of interactions, with no logic or coherency in interactions. It all boils down just standing like a chimp in front of NPCs you wish to engage with and spamming dialogue options until you get high enough relations that they decide to acknowledge your existence and give you what you expect from them. At no point this system even attempts to make sense and you find yourself chaining nonsensical interactions. It is *so bad*.

- The graphical fidelity still gets in the way of readability on many objects and terrain. Beyond the aesthetic choice, it's just so low fidelity that one struggles to just make sense of what's on screen most of the time, and while in many games this sort of aesthetic can look pleasing when done right, this just looks unreadable, visually busy and unappealing.

- The performance, which was a big problem when i first picked the game up during EA, has been improved, although i'm still experiencing memory leaks and major slowdowns with very little on the screen = Automatic negative review. Those leaks were identified over a year ago, there was ample time to fix them.

- Feature wise it's rather rich in my opinion but content wise it's still rather devoid of content and sadly my understanding is that the dev simply had to push it out the door for lack of funds. In this game you'll find very little story-driven elements and hand-crafted narratives. What's there is good, but it's insufficient. For a sandbox game like this one, it feels very empty.

- The soundscape is still very bland, which for a game purporting to immerse you, is a big let-down.

- The game pushes you to hire a crew but the whole crew management/interaction gameplay (and especially performance, yikes) feels very janky. 

- Outside of the few handcrafted quests, the rest is typical sandbox busy work nonsense fluff and fetch-quests. Yawn.

- Jobs (non handcrafted quests) tend to be buggy and break, leading players to decide to just skip this entire area and to focus on other revenue streams.

So what's there to enjoy then?

- The ship piloting feels excellent.
- The scavenging, albeit repetitive as sin over time, is interesting.
- Ship building is interesting to engage with and has plenty of features to deal with.
- Exploring, although limited because again, world feels bland, empty and unfinished.
- There's some measure of hope for this game as it features a steam workshop integration.
- Murder investigations, if they weren't still as buggy, would be enjoyable as well.

My hope for the game is that the dev keeps working on it to finish what was clearly not yet cooked and ready to come out of the oven. On top of that, i hope for modders to address the main issues of this game, first and foremost the unforgivably bad NPC interaction system, and if at all possible, the UI.

As it stands though, do yourself a favor and do not engage until significant work is done on this title. It's a big let down for me and i'm sorry about it because i have a lot of respect for the Dev as a person, but this soured me on supporting their future endeavors a great deal.
items.text_zh:
恐怕我只能说，就目前这个样子，我实在没法推荐购买。

- 角色创建很糟糕，缺少预设和预设保存之类的功能，不过反正这也没那么重要，因为只有一个玩家模型，不管你选了什么，它看起来都完全不像你的角色。这不仅仅是个视觉元素的问题，我也很讨厌角色创建里的随机性元素。

- UI 糟透了。事实上，我觉得这绝对是我在电子游戏里遇到过的最烂的 UI，我可是经历过 DOS 时代的人。信息杂乱无章，呈现得很差，意味着要疯狂点击，那些（过多的）UI 元素在图形/逻辑上几乎没有连贯性，处理这一切简直就是一段糟糕透顶、糟糕透顶的体验。当然，你*可以*习惯它。但这本身就是糟糕的设计，在整个 EA 阶段一直存在，本该被废弃重做。团队里没有 UI/UX 方面的人，这一点很遗憾地暴露无遗。无论是物品栏、角色信息、地形还是别的什么，你全程都得在忍受它的同时努力让自己玩得开心。

- 这游戏的整个前提是营造一种“心灵剧场”（这是开发者的话，不是我说的），但整个 NPC 交互系统就是糟糕透顶。它本质上是《模拟人生》那种交互，交互中毫无逻辑或连贯性。一切都归结为像只黑猩猩一样站在你想互动的 NPC 面前，狂刷对话选项，直到关系值够高，他们才决定承认你的存在，给你你期望从他们那里得到的东西。这个系统在任何时候都甚至没有尝试过要讲得通，你会发现自己在一连串毫无意义的交互中循环。它*太糟了*。

- 图形保真度仍然妨碍着许多物体和地形的可读性。抛开审美选择不谈，它的保真度就是太低了，大多数时候人都很难看懂屏幕上是什么，虽然在很多游戏里这种审美如果做得好会看起来令人愉悦，但这个看起来就是难以辨认、视觉上杂乱且毫无吸引力。

- 性能问题，在我最初于 EA 阶段入手这游戏时是个大问题，现在已经有所改善，不过我仍然会遇到内存泄漏和严重的卡顿，而屏幕上几乎没什么东西 = 自动差评。那些泄漏一年多以前就被发现了，有充足的时间去修复。

- 就功能而言，在我看来相当丰富，但就内容而言，它仍然相当缺乏内容，而且遗憾的是，据我所知，开发者只是因为缺钱不得不把它赶着推出门。在这个游戏里，你会发现极少有剧情驱动的元素和手工打造的叙事。现有的内容是不错，但不够。对于像这样的沙盒游戏来说，它感觉非常空洞。

- 音景仍然非常平淡，对于一个号称要让你沉浸其中的游戏来说，这是很大的失望。

- 游戏推动你去雇佣一支船员，但整个船员管理/交互的玩法（尤其是性能，哎呀）感觉非常蹩脚。

- 除了少数几个手工打造的任务之外，其余都是典型的沙盒式忙碌工作、无意义的填充内容和跑腿任务。呵欠。

- 工作（非手工打造的任务）往往有 bug 并且会出故障，导致玩家决定干脆跳过这整个区域，转而专注于其他收入来源。

那么还有什么可享受的呢？

- 飞船驾驶手感极佳。
- 拾荒，尽管时间久了重复得要命，但挺有意思。
- 飞船建造玩起来很有意思，而且有大量功能可以折腾。
- 探索，尽管受限，因为还是那句话，世界感觉平淡、空洞且未完成。
- 这游戏还有一定希望，因为它集成了 Steam 创意工坊。
- 谋杀案调查，如果它们不是仍然那么多 bug 的话，也会挺有趣的。

我对这游戏的希望是开发者继续努力，把那些显然还没煮熟、还没准备好出炉的东西做完。除此之外，我希望模组作者能解决这游戏的主要问题，首当其冲的就是那不可原谅的糟糕 NPC 交互系统，如果可能的话，还有 UI。

不过就目前而言，行行好，在这个作品有重大改进之前别去碰它。这让我非常失望，我也为此感到遗憾，因为我个人非常尊重这位开发者，但这件事让我在支持他们未来事业方面大打了折扣。

Atmosphere and gameplay are ok'ish, a mix of FTL and Rimworld. nothing new, it does the job.

The main problem is the graphic style, it is way too much  (pixels, invasive and completely different artwork ...) all mixed together it is just awful and doesn't give a visual identity to the game. 

As a result you never know on what you are walking or what you are selecting. As soon as it gets messy, like on derelict ships, it's impossible to identify anything correctly. you have to click over every floor till to know what it is, and most of the time you misslick and select another element since everything is so pixelized you don't know where it starts and ends.

The inventory and container system is also overly complicated to make it look like you need to manage it. In reality you can put a crowbar into your trousers pocket, scraps into a lamp,... everything is only taking one slot and not stackable, making sure you turn every containers into a pile of ♥♥♥♥.

Also the interaction/chat system with NPC doesn't make much sense, a mix of RPG text-based chat with a tiny ass window you have to scroll into to do things. you have to pause every 2 seconds to read what is going on. Funny thing, televisions or radio dialogs are displayed directly next to them.

That is the whole problem, everything is mixed together and so different (UI, arts, character, chat,...) that is doesn't blend well.
items.text_zh:
氛围和玩法还算可以，像是《FTL》和《环世界》的混合体。没什么新意，但能玩。

主要问题在于美术风格，它太过分了（像素、侵入感强且完全不同的美术……）全部混在一起简直糟糕透顶，没有给游戏带来任何视觉识别度。

结果就是你永远不知道自己在什么上面走，或者选中了什么。一旦变得杂乱，比如在废弃飞船上，就根本不可能正确辨认任何东西。你得把每个地板都点一遍才知道那是什么，而且大多数时候你会点错并选中另一个元素，因为一切都像素化到你不知道它从哪开始、到哪结束。

物品栏和容器系统也过于复杂，像是故意让你觉得需要管理它。实际上你可以把撬棍塞进裤子口袋，把废料塞进台灯里……所有东西都只占一个格子且不可堆叠，保证你把每个容器都变成一堆♥♥♥♥。

另外与NPC的互动/聊天系统也不太合理，像是RPG文字聊天混合了一个你得滚动操作的小得可怜的窗口。你每2秒就得暂停一下去读发生了什么。有趣的是，电视或收音机的对话却直接显示在旁边。

这就是整个问题所在，所有东西都混在一起又如此不同（UI、美术、角色、聊天……），根本融合不到一块去。

items.text:
184 hours in, and Ostranauts is one of the most immersive space games I’ve ever played.

I’m a big fan of KSP, Space Engineers, Stationeers, and The Expanse. But Ostranauts gives me something none of them quite manage to do: it makes me feel like I’m actually living a life in space.

And not the heroic kind.

You’re just some poor bastard trying to survive, make money, keep your ship running, and hopefully not blow yourself up because you assembled or started your reactor incorrectly.

The simulation is incredible: atmosphere, pressure, temperature, electricity, gases, engines, reactors, character needs, economy, jobs, exploration. And yes, the game is difficult to learn. That’s not a downside — the complexity is a huge part of the immersion.

For example, learning how to properly assemble and start a reactor takes only about 20 hours of real life instead of 10 years. Progress!

I built my current ship completely from scratch, trying to create the perfect ship for every situation.

It only took me about 100 hours. :)

But the best part of Ostranauts is the stories it creates.

I once accidentally inflated my ship to insane pressure with a turbopump while trying to figure out the airlock.

My in-game mother paid for my visa to Venus.

And during my first pirate encounter, I was sitting in my underwear desperately trying to patch a hole in my ship when a pirate broke in. I panicked, hit him with a screwdriver…

…and accidentally killed him with one hit.

That is Ostranauts.

My biggest criticism is the graphics. The pixel-art style is dirty and visually cluttered, and sometimes it’s genuinely difficult to understand what you’re looking at or where things are. That’s basically the reason this isn’t a 10/10 for me.

But underneath those pixels is a space simulation unlike anything else I’ve played. You can start over and live a completely different life, build a completely different ship, make different mistakes, and come away with completely different stories.

If you love KSP, Space Engineers, Stationeers, or you’ve ever watched The Expanse and thought, “I don’t want to be Holden. I want to be some poor bastard desperately trying to keep an old ship from falling apart,” this game is for you.

9/10. Would spend another 20 hours learning how not to explode my reactor.
items.text_zh:
玩了184个小时，Ostranauts是我玩过的最具沉浸感的太空游戏之一。

我是KSP、Space Engineers、Stationeers和《苍穹浩瀚》的忠实粉丝。但Ostranauts给了我它们都没能完全做到的东西：它让我感觉自己真的在太空中生活。

而且不是那种英雄式的生活。

你只是个可怜的混蛋，努力求生、赚钱、让飞船保持运转，还希望不会因为组装或启动反应堆的方式不对而把自己炸飞。

模拟系统令人难以置信：大气、压力、温度、电力、气体、引擎、反应堆、角色需求、经济、工作、探索。没错，这游戏很难上手。这不是缺点——复杂性正是沉浸感的重要来源。

比如说，学会如何正确组装并启动一个反应堆只需要大约20小时现实时间，而不是10年。进步了！

我当前的飞船完全是从零开始建造的，试图打造一艘能应对所有情况的完美飞船。

只花了我大约100个小时。:)

但Ostranauts最棒的部分是它创造的故事。

有一次，我在试图搞明白气闸怎么用的时候，不小心用涡轮泵把飞船充到了疯狂的压力。

我在游戏里的母亲为我支付了去金星的签证费。

还有在我第一次遭遇海盗时，我正穿着内裤拼命试图修补飞船上的一个洞，这时一个海盗闯了进来。我慌了，用螺丝刀打了他一下……

……然后一下不小心把他打死了。

这就是Ostranauts。

我最大的批评是画面。像素艺术风格又脏又视觉杂乱，有时候真的很难看清你在看什么或者东西在哪里。这基本上就是它对我来说不是10/10的原因。

但在那些像素之下，是一种我从未玩过的太空模拟。你可以重新开始，过一种完全不同的生活，建造一艘完全不同的飞船，犯不同的错误，然后带着完全不同的故事离开。

如果你喜欢KSP、Space Engineers、Stationeers，或者你曾看过《苍穹浩瀚》然后想：“我不想当霍尔登。我想当某个可怜的混蛋，拼命让一艘老飞船不散架”，那这游戏就是为你准备的。

9/10。愿意再花20个小时学习如何不把我的反应堆炸掉。

Get a few pennies collecting scrap. Owe more in docking fees. Run out of fuel, not to be able to afford to leave the station to fly to an unknown location to investigate a dead body. Get debt-locked. Uninstall. 

There a harsh games. But this takes the cake.

Also - pixelated 2d clutter on the floor makes no sense, you have no clue what to salvage and what to ignore. And, no real flight, just an old radar style screen with more 2d map navigation.

 Avoid.

I've not been this happy with a game in years. I am amazed how detailed everything is. I'll be honest when I first turned it on I was like 'Woooooooooooooooooooot????' it is very intimidating and I've spent half my time on google on my phone while playing, but it is so worth it. I love the flying mechanics, it's so interactive and its all done through buttons and knobs and little flick switches and different screens on your nav console, everything does something and when I come back to port I feel triumphant. There is a lot to manage and keep on top of maintaining your ship and keeping it stocked up, paying fees, buying licences that don't last, managing your own body, getting contracts, and so much more I've barely scratched the surface. One small gripe I have is the graphics could be clearer it is hard to see what's what, a lot of stuff is very pixely and kind of all blends in sometimes good luck finding batteries you put down somewhere etc.
There's so much I've not touched on or just don't know about yet but the Devs have done incredible work here and  the passion is clear, thank you.

items.text: Good game concept and solid gameplay loop where you have a massive loan to pay off through salvaging and other missions. The game has nice features when managing your spaceship such as room atmosphere and pressure, electrical wiring, and repairs. It takes some time to get a hold of what you are doing and how things operate in general, there are some manuals but a lot of things you have to figure out yourself. Visually objects may at first seem unclear as to what they are as lot of things look vaguely similar in order to fit the pixel art style, but with some time they became familiar and this no longer bothers me. I recommend it if you are into hardcore space sims, you can get a load of hours out of it - but you do have to put some effort in to squeeze the juice out, which can be a good thing

items.text:
This game should be right up my alley, and in almost all aspects it is. It is gritty, has a distinct survival feel, good game loop, good characters, and success at anything feels hard earned and therefore even more rewarding.
However, with a sad heart, I must give it a thumbs down because of one absolutely game breaking thing, IMO: the graphics. I don't mind the blocky look at all. But the contrast between interactive items and the regular environment is so bad that many useful things are hard to see, to an extent that simply annoys me. I miss storage racks, switches and whatnot, simply because they are all part of the same indistinguishable pixel soup. This could be one of my favorite games, but with the graphics in this state, it is annoyingly unplayable for me.

然而，怀着难过的心情，我必须给它一个差评，因为在我看来有一个绝对破坏游戏的问题：画面。我完全不介意方块风格。但可交互物品与普通环境之间的对比度太差了，以至于许多有用的东西都很难看清，到了单纯让我恼火的程度。我会错过储物架、开关之类的东西，仅仅因为它们全都属于同一锅无法分辨的像素汤。这本可以是我最喜欢的游戏之一，但在画面处于这种状态下，对我来说它烦人得没法玩。

items.text:
Normally I don't do reviews mainly because I play a lot of games that have thousands of reviews saying its amazing. But this game... takes amazing to the next level.

I am highly impressed by everything it includes. From the ship customization, 02 bottles, eva suits and the economy plus the orbits of planets and stations... its an amazing game. 

HOWEVER, it is hard to learn at first - BUT EXTREMELY rewarding and fun especially if you like scavenging, building and progressing as a player. 

I would love to see more automation for example when you have 500 plus items looted from a ship I wish there was a button which can fast forward to the end of all your repairs... I also have found sleep extremely annoying as sometimes I have to sleep 18 hours to get rested but other times just a few hours. Which is ultimately really boring. So I would love to see a feature that allows you to sleep until rested or something of that nature - even if it is a mod. 

I would also say that the graphics are lacking... It is really difficult to see things as there can be a lot of clutter. So I would suggest either A) redoing ALL of the items/equipment B) creating different views for people. For example a view that does not show all the conduits that would help, or perhaps a search bar showing you where something is in your ship as at times its hard to find. 

As I haven't really done a whole lot in the game besides salvage and build my ship I am wondering if there are other aspects to the game such as bounty hunting etc as there are no real tutorials. I wish all the aspects of the game were more obvious.

Overall amazing game so far.

通常我不写评测，主要是因为我玩的很多游戏都有成千上万条评测说它很棒。但这款游戏……把很棒提升到了另一个层次。

它包含的一切都让我印象深刻。从飞船自定义、氧气瓶、EVA宇航服，到经济系统，再加上行星和空间站的轨道……这是一款很棒的游戏。

然而，一开始很难学——但回报极高，也很有趣，尤其是如果你喜欢打捞、建造和作为玩家不断进步。

我很想看到更多自动化，例如当你从一艘飞船上搜刮了500多件物品时，我希望有一个按钮可以快进到你所有修理工作的结尾……我还觉得睡觉极其烦人，因为有时我得睡18个小时才能休息好，但其他时候只要几个小时。这最终真的很无聊。所以我很想看到一个能让你睡到休息好为止之类的功能——即使是mod也好。

我还要说画面有所欠缺……真的很难看清东西，因为可能会有很多杂乱。所以我建议要么A）重做所有物品/装备，要么B）为人们创建不同的视图。例如，一个不显示所有管线的视图会有帮助，或者也许一个搜索栏，显示你飞船里某样东西在哪里，因为有时候很难找到。

由于我在游戏里除了打捞和建造我的飞船之外并没有真正做太多事情，我想知道游戏是否还有其他方面，比如赏金狩猎等等，因为并没有真正的教程。我希望游戏的所有方面都更明显。

总的来说，到目前为止是很棒的游戏。

items.text:
Really enjoying this game so far. 

I have to admit the first time I tried it, it was maybe a bit too daunting, and i was on steam deck. I didn't quite give it the time it deserved and it wasn't until I recently came back to it that I have seen how it shines.

Its a big confusing complex world with many fiddly systems and things to learn, but you are given a level of freedom in space to do things your way that scratches all of my itches.

Basic loop is roll into a character, make some choices and land with a weak body and a ship that you owe tonnes of money on. learn how to repair, breakdown, and build ships and venture out into deep space to find your target.

Starting tips: definitely start with a gig from the gig nexus. there are a couple easy body identification ones available <not sure how random these are, only my most recent character did gigs, and had 2x gigs for murdered corpses on the same ship. netted me 50K not including salvaging their ship.

but wait, if you want to salvage purchase a salvaging license from the licenses kiosk, good for 24h and up. your license also has to be valid to sell your salvage back to said kiosk. otherwise you need a criminal trait to deal with black market.

but wait, is your ship airtight? does it have oxygen tanks that arent leaking and a working pump hooked up to an o2 sensor ? did you remember to don your spacesuit ? is your ship fueled? did you bring the proper tools for salvaging ? do you have a battery charger for your welder gun ? 

does any of this complexity and immediate and constant danger sound fun? try this game if so. because its an emergent gameplay beast.

sidenote: i recently encountered a space pirate on a hulk ship. (said ship had a nuclear reactor on it, great $$$) after trying to fight him, evade him, and salvage his ship components from a space walk, he followed me on to my ship. I managed to lock him outside my airlock and promptly flew to a nearby Police ship and requested docking with it. the officer dealt with my pirate friend and i collected his weapons and was on my merry way to take his nuclear reactor, pellet feeder, and laser array. what a glorious game.

Graphics: low-fi and at times busy and messy. but i wouldn't change a thing. character portraits are lovely, and the  painted scenes lush.

Music and SFX : excellent. nice ambient music and sound, everything is appropriate. It might be nice in the future to have music devices for playback,

Features: pretty rich and presumably growing in the future. some things a bit lacking like social interactions and combat is a little messy and confusing. Ship salvaging and building is pretty good though, however it would be nice to have some middle ground between task orders and manually doing things. Let us queue tasks from the context menu, it makes no sense to be able to queue endlessly with the order system, but if using the context menu you have to cancel current action to start another. queue queue queue. 

Also autotask is nice, to allow your character to make the choice of walking to the cabin to vent co2, but can we improve it so they dont want until current task is complete? if repairing or installing something, they will damn near die on the spot to finish before going to vent.

I guess thats it for now, bottom line : amazing game, can't wait to see it grow more.

到目前为止真的很喜欢这款游戏。

我得承认，第一次尝试时，它可能有点太令人生畏了，而且我当时用的是Steam Deck。我没有给它应得的时间，直到最近重新回来玩，我才看到它的闪光点。

这是一个庞大、令人困惑、复杂的世界，有许多繁琐的系统和需要学习的东西，但你在太空中拥有一定程度的自由，可以按自己的方式做事，这满足了我所有的渴望。

基本循环是：创建一个角色，做出一些选择，然后带着虚弱的身体和一艘欠了一屁股债的飞船落地。学习如何修理、拆解和建造飞船，然后冒险进入深空寻找你的目标。

新手提示：一定要从任务枢纽接一个任务开始。有几个简单的尸体鉴定任务可用 <不确定这些有多随机，只有我最近的角色做过任务，而且同一艘飞船上接到了2个被谋杀尸体的任务。净赚了5万，还不包括打捞他们的飞船。

但是等等，如果你想打捞，要从许可证亭购买打捞许可证，有效期24小时起。你的许可证还必须有效，才能把打捞物卖回给那个亭子。否则你需要一个犯罪特质来应对黑市。

但是等等，你的飞船气密吗？它的氧气罐没有泄漏吗？有连接到氧气传感器的工作泵吗？你记得穿上宇航服了吗？你的飞船加燃料了吗？你带了合适的打捞工具吗？你有电焊枪的电池充电器吗？

这种复杂性和即时且持续的危险听起来有趣吗？如果有趣，就试试这款游戏吧。因为它是一个涌现式玩法的猛兽。

附注：我最近在一艘废船上遇到了一个太空海盗。（那艘船上有一个核反应堆，值大钱$$$）在试图与他战斗、躲避他，并在太空行走中打捞他的飞船部件之后，他跟着我上了我的飞船。我设法把他锁在我的气闸外面，然后迅速飞向附近的一艘警察飞船，请求与其对接。警官处理了我的海盗朋友，我收集了他的武器，然后愉快地继续去拿他的核反应堆、弹丸供给器和激光阵列。多么辉煌的一款游戏。

画面：低保真，有时繁杂凌乱。但我一点也不会改。角色肖像很可爱，手绘场景很茂盛。

音乐和音效：极好。不错的环境音乐和音效，一切都恰到好处。如果将来能有音乐设备用于播放，可能会很不错，

功能：相当丰富，想必未来还会增长。有些东西略显不足，比如社交互动，战斗有点凌乱和令人困惑。不过飞船打捞和建造相当不错，然而如果能在任务指令和手动做事之间有一些中间地带就好了。让我们从上下文菜单排队任务吧，用指令系统能无限排队，这毫无道理，但如果使用上下文菜单，你必须取消当前动作才能开始另一个。排队排队排队。

另外自动任务也不错，让你的角色自己选择走到舱室排放二氧化碳，但能不能改进一下，让他们不要等到当前任务完成？如果在修理或安装什么东西，他们几乎会当场死掉也要先完成才去排气。

我想目前就这些了，底线：惊人的游戏，迫不及待想看到它成长更多。

编辑 - 为了扩展任务排队，请给我们一个上下文菜单搬运选项：
1：右键点击，选择搬运
2：滚动到目标目的地并选择 
使用适当的物体网格尺寸指定目标地砖的目的地
3：确认并移动到下一个排队的搬运任务。

在处理单人场景对比船员自主性时，这比命令和任务系统要干净得多。

I don't know how to review this game to be honest. 

There's definitely something cool here, I really like the premise of being a loner in space with my ship, going around salvaging and exploring the solar system. It feels like it could be a really good game.

It might be the tutorial that's putting me off, I'm not sure, it breaks really easily and doesn't really show the game's true potential I don't think.

I'm going to play a bit more and come back with an update, I'm on the fence with this one right now!
----------------------------
Edit, Update after 17 hours of play time

I'm enjoying the game for the most part, it definitely takes time to get used to. 
I had to watch a few youtube videos to find out how to build and expand my ship.

It still needs a fair bit of polish, the UI can be clumsy, boxes popping up all over the place. I don't get any warnings when my ship battery is running low, or if I'm running low on O2 or N2. At one point my ship just turned off, I didn't know why, I ended up having to google what had happened - My ships battery had ran out!

Sometimes when I dismantle items in my ship, if I'm close to a wall, the items spawn outside the ship and cannot be retrieved if you are docked at a station.

When my EVA suit is running low on battery, I don't get any prompt of any kind, then my character starts to aphyxiate and I didn't understand why until my character passed out and I started clicking stuff randomly - only to find out the battery was at 0%.

It was hard to figure out how to get my character to sleep, the only way I could do it was by setting 2 hours of sleep on the "roster" and then telling my character to sleep in a bed at the station, then using hyper fast forward I managed to get them to sleep for 2 hours - This is a complicated mechanic and needs explaining better.

It would be GREAT if we could label/name crates and bins, and/or change their colour - at present, all the bins and crates look the same and I keep forgetting what I put in which one. If I could label one as O2 Bottles, another as Batteries, another as scrap metal, it would be a brilliant quality of life addition.

Another thing I've noticed is the performance, I'm not sure if the game has a memory leak or something, but the longer I play the game, the lower my frame rate gets over time. (I'm running a RX 9070XT, 32Gb RAM and a R7 3700X) Eventually my fps starts to drop to like 29 and I have to save and re-load the game, weird!

Overall I am enjoying the game, the gameplay loop is addictive and stripping wrecks of parts to sell or install on my own ship is very satisfying.

The game is very promising, with a bit of polish and some better tutorials I think it could be a great game.

说实话，我不知道该怎么评价这款游戏。

这里肯定有很酷的东西，我真的很喜欢这个设定：独自一人在太空中，驾驶着自己的飞船，四处打捞、探索太阳系。感觉这本来可以是一款非常棒的游戏。

也许是教程让我望而却步，我不确定，它很容易出问题，而且我觉得它并没有真正展现出游戏的潜力。

我打算再玩一会儿，然后回来更新，目前我对这款游戏还在犹豫！
----------------------------
编辑，游玩17小时后的更新

大部分时间我挺享受这款游戏的，它确实需要花时间适应。
我不得不看了几个YouTube视频，才搞清楚如何建造和扩展我的飞船。

它仍然需要相当多的打磨，UI可能很笨拙，各种框到处弹出来。当我的飞船电池电量低，或者我的O2或N2不足时，我得不到任何警告。有一次我的飞船直接关机了，我不知道为什么，最后不得不上网搜发生了什么——我的飞船电池耗尽了！

有时当我在飞船里拆解物品时，如果我靠近墙壁，物品会生成到飞船外面，而如果你停靠在空间站，就无法取回它们。

当我的EVA宇航服电量低时，我得不到任何形式的提示，然后我的角色开始窒息，我不明白为什么，直到我的角色昏过去，我开始随机点击东西——才发现电池电量是0%。

很难搞清楚如何让我的角色睡觉，我唯一能做到的方法是在“名册”上设置2小时睡眠，然后让我的角色在空间站的床上睡觉，接着使用超快进，我才设法让他们睡了2小时——这是个复杂的机制，需要更好地解释。

如果我们能给箱子和储物箱贴标签/命名，和/或改变它们的颜色，那就太好了——目前所有储物箱和箱子看起来都一样，我总是忘记哪个里面放了什么。如果我能把一个标为O2瓶，另一个标为电池，再一个标为废金属，那将是一个极棒的生活质量改进。

我还注意到的另一件事是性能，我不确定游戏是否有内存泄漏之类的问题，但我玩得越久，帧率就会随着时间越来越低。（我用的是RX 9070XT、32Gb内存和R7 3700X）最终我的fps开始掉到大概29，我不得不保存并重新加载游戏，真奇怪！

总的来说，我很享受这款游戏，玩法循环很上瘾，从残骸上拆下零件去卖或安装到自己的飞船上非常令人满足。

这款游戏非常有前途，只要稍加打磨和一些更好的教程，我认为它可以成为一款很棒的游戏。

items.text:
Невероятно залипательная игра для своего жанра, наверное для меня это одно из открытий этого года. Я наиграл в пиратскую версию более 100 часов, как появилась возможность купил её. Начнем за здравие и закончим за упокой. Вот что я заметил.

Плюсы: 
1. Глубокая атмосфера, которая к сожалению становится реже со временем, так как катсцены одноразовые и редки, но куча лора на КПК. Тут буквально можно распечатать гайды этой игры на бумаге и положить на свой стол для большего погружения.
2. Геймплей невероятно залипательный, пусть и в начале довольно непонятно. Я бы описал интерес к этой игре положительной логарифмической функцией, думаешь что уже все посмотрел, а все равно интерес постепенно растет.
3. Очень приятное комьюнити, возможно дело в специфике игры.
4. Разработчики не иронично невероятные солнышки, вызывают доверие, они развернуто отвечают в дискорде даже на тупые предложения добавить какую-то бесполезную хрень. Буквально выкладывают гайд на гитхаб как взламывать их .dll файлы и декомпилировать их. Регулярно выпускают обновления, реально работают, пытаются фиксить баги. 
5. Игра по хорошей цене, я бы сказал даже низкой, возможно разработчики позже повысят её после релиза.
6. Возможность реального отыгрыша своего персонажа, лично я рекомендую отыгрывать для большего интереса. Надеюсь разработчики добавят что-то типа рп целей и случайных желаний с катсценами.

А теперь о плохом, минусы:
1. Отсутствие других языков, только английский. Я понимаю что это инди студия, но они бы могли открыть на гитхабе или где-то еще репо для переводов от комьюнити. Как к примеру это сделали в SCP SL.
2. Наверное самое критическое, это оптимизация. Скорость x16 очень сильно нагружает процессор, а главное что оно работает ТОЛЬКО в одном потоке, на физических ядрах. И почему-то потребляет еще и E ядра, да в целом любые физические ядра в одном потоке, а не определенные. Хотя когда я ограничиваю на 2-3 ядра, оно работает стабильнее и нагружается в 2-3 раза меньше.
TL:DR, не советую играть если у вас проц слабее 12600. Но а то что в минималках Dual Core 2 GHz, это критическое надувательство.
3. Засоряет оперативную память через пару часов игры, желательно иметь 32 гига или хотя бы 16.
4. Частые приколы вылезающие в консоль, но особо не влияющие на геймплей.
5. Плохая графика, хотя арты в катсценах неплохие.
6. Кто-то сказал что игра сырая, НО РЕБЯТ, я столько играл в игры которые РЕАЛЬНО сырые. А это более чем играбельно, еще и моды уже есть.
7. Сломанная экономика, в начале сложно, но к середине игры ты забудешь что ты не живешь в мире где победил коммунизм, а так-то тут все за деньги.

Итог: Я считаю вполне хороший продукт, есть минусы, да, но кому щас легко? Лично для меня самым большим плюсом оказалось сообщество игры, разработчики и залипательный геймплей. Думаю очень многим игра не понравится. Но лично я рекомендую если минусы для вас не критичны. Всем добра и позитива, поцеловал, обнял, расплакался.

对于它所属的类型来说，这是一款令人难以置信地上瘾的游戏，对我来说大概是今年的发现之一。我在盗版版本里玩了100多个小时，一有机会就买下了它。咱们先扬后抑吧。以下是我注意到的地方。

优点：
1. 氛围深厚，可惜随着时间推移会变得越来越少，因为过场动画是一次性的而且很稀少，但电脑里有一大堆背景设定。你简直可以把这游戏的攻略打印在纸上，放在自己桌上，以获得更强的沉浸感。
2. 玩法令人难以置信地上瘾，尽管一开始相当让人摸不着头脑。我会把对这款游戏的兴趣描述为一个正对数函数，你以为自己已经看遍了一切，但兴趣仍然在逐渐增长。
3. 非常友好的社区，也许是因为这游戏的特殊性。
4. 开发者们毫不讽刺地是难以置信的小太阳，让人信任，他们会在Discord里详细回复，哪怕是那些想添加某些没用的破玩意儿的蠢建议。他们甚至直接在GitHub上发布如何破解他们的.dll文件并反编译它们的指南。他们定期发布更新，真的在干活，努力修bug。
5. 游戏价格不错，我甚至想说偏低，也许开发者会在正式发售后涨价。
6. 可以真正地扮演自己的角色，我个人建议为了更有意思去进行角色扮演。希望开发者能加入类似角色扮演目标和带过场动画的随机愿望之类的东西。

现在说坏的，缺点：
1. 没有其他语言，只有英语。我理解这是独立工作室，但他们本可以在GitHub或其他地方开一个社区翻译的仓库。就像SCP SL做的那样。
2. 大概是最关键的，就是优化。x16速度对处理器负载非常大，而且最重要的是它只在一个线程上运行，在物理核心上。而且不知为何还会占用E核，总之是任何物理核心都在单线程里，而不是特定的核心。不过当我限制到2-3个核心时，它运行得更稳定，负载也少2-3倍。
TL:DR，如果你的处理器比12600弱，我不建议玩。而最低配置写的是双核2 GHz，这是严重的欺诈。
3. 玩几个小时后会塞满内存，最好有32G或者至少16G。
4. 控制台里经常冒出些搞笑的东西，但对玩法影响不大。
5. 画面很差，尽管过场动画里的美术还不错。
6. 有人说这游戏是半成品，但是兄弟们，我玩过那么多真正半成品的游戏。而这个远不止能玩，甚至已经有mod了。
7. 经济系统崩坏，一开始很难，但到游戏中期你就会忘记自己并不是生活在一个共产主义胜利了的世界里，而这里一切都要花钱。

总结：我认为这是一个相当不错的产品，有缺点，是的，但谁现在容易呢？对我个人来说，最大的优点就是游戏的社区、开发者和令人上瘾的玩法。我想很多人不会喜欢这游戏。但如果你觉得这些缺点不致命，我个人推荐。祝大家善良和积极，亲亲，抱抱，哭了。

items.text:
A hidden gem behind a market saturated with remakes and vanilla garbage. It's like The Expanse simulator. A very immersive, in depth space opera RPG with a satisfying game loop. This is one you'll sink hours into before you make it out of the starting area. Not to mention the extremely active developer who listens to feedback from the community.
A few negatives since everyone else is doing the positives better than me:
1. There are bugs, but it's EA and they are rare At my current playtime ive had zero game breaking bugs. Minor performance drops and stuttering.
2. This game has the cringey body type/non-bianary option. Also every interaction with NPCs of your gender is gay which is weird. 
3. The art style is not my cup of tea. There's a lot of MS Paint stuff going on and its strange.
4. Most development up to this point has been all QOL changes and very very little content. The roadmap doesn't seem to add anything like new equipment, new ships, scalable equipment and so on. 

Overall if you love the treasure hunter, hard-core space sim type gameloops you're going to love this. Ostranauts has the potential to be a masterpiece with some time in the oven. I also hope they dont add in political messaging and kill the whole project.

既然其他人把优点说得比我好，那我就说几个缺点：
1. 有bug，但这是EA阶段，而且很少见。在我目前的游戏时间里，我遇到过零个破坏游戏的bug。只有轻微的性能下降和卡顿。
2. 这游戏有那种令人尴尬的体型/非二元性别选项。而且与同性别NPC的每次互动都是同性恋，这很奇怪。
3. 美术风格不合我口味。有很多像MS Paint画出来的东西，很奇怪。
4. 到目前为止，大部分开发都是QOL改动，内容非常非常少。路线图似乎没有添加任何新装备、新飞船、可扩展装备之类的东西。

总的来说，如果你喜欢寻宝猎人、硬核太空模拟类型的游戏循环，你会爱上这个。Ostranauts有潜力在打磨一段时间后成为杰作。我也希望他们不要加入政治信息，毁掉整个项目。

items.text:
If you liked the tv show The Expanse and wanted to play a game as one of the Belters (beltas!) living our your space fantasy among the asteroids, this is pretty dang close!

I'm only 2 hours in, but really enjoy what I've seen so far.  A surprisingly complex group of systems that actually make sense when you take a moment to understand them.  From navigating your ship to dismantling/repair/upgrade/install/uninstall all the various parts of your ship.  Even the conversations with NPC's are nothing I've seen before, but interesting how they tie into the specific personalities of not only the specific NPC you are talking to, but also your own characters personality.    

You can also interact with basically everything. There's a contextual menu (default: Right-Click) for everything. If there's more than one tile in a space, right-clicking again cycles through the context menu for each item in the space.

There's a LOT of freedom in this game so far and I look forward to trying out various gameplay features that I've yet to try or discover.   

I may come back to this review after I've played a few more hours. So far this game is in a very unique area, kind of reminds of Kenshi's 'you are just a peasant' kind of feeling, mixed with Rimworld's personality/workers autonomous gameplay also mixed with Space Haven's 'build/repair/swap ship parts piece by piece' gameplay...or as I mentioned before, playing as a Belter from The Expanse.

My 2 pieces of constructive criticism (hopefully the devs are listening!) are related.

1) The graphic style, while the style is fine, the details of what I'm looking at are hard to decipher. I spent the first few minutes of the game literally just staring at the screen trying to figure out what I was looking at.  

This leads into..

2) I have a hard time seeing the separation of spaces (i.e. ship, docking port, station, etc).  Unless I hover my mouse over everything and get the tooltip, I have a hard time understanding if I'm on my ship or a ship/station I've docked at, etc.  

It might be intentional and perhaps spending more time in game I'll get more familiar with the shapes/colors of the tiles to better understand what I'm looking at.

如果你喜欢电视剧《苍穹浩瀚》，并且想玩一款游戏，扮演贝尔特人（beltas！）中的一员，在小行星之间实现你的太空幻想，那这款游戏就非常接近了！

我只玩了2个小时，但真的很喜欢目前看到的内容。一组出乎意料复杂的系统，当你花点时间理解它们时，实际上很合理。从驾驶你的飞船，到拆解/修理/升级/安装/卸载飞船的各种部件。甚至与NPC的对话也是我以前从未见过的，但有趣的是，它们不仅与你正在交谈的特定NPC的个性相关联，也与你自己的角色个性相关联。    

你基本上还可以与一切互动。所有东西都有上下文菜单（默认：右键单击）。如果一个空间里有不止一个格子，再次右键单击会循环显示该空间中每个物品的上下文菜单。

到目前为止，这款游戏有非常多的自由，我期待尝试各种我尚未尝试或发现的玩法功能。   

在我再玩几个小时后，我可能会回来更新这条评测。到目前为止，这款游戏处于一个非常独特的位置，有点让人想起《Kenshi》那种“你只是个农民”的感觉，混合了《RimWorld》的个性/工人自主玩法，也混合了《Space Haven》的“逐件建造/修理/更换飞船部件”玩法……或者如我之前提到的，扮演《苍穹浩瀚》中的贝尔特人。

我的2条建设性批评（希望开发者们在听！）是相关的。

1）图形风格，虽然风格本身没问题，但我正在看的东西的细节很难辨认。游戏开始的头几分钟，我 literally 只是盯着屏幕，试图弄清楚我在看什么。  

这引出了……

2）我很难看出空间之间的分隔（即飞船、对接端口、空间站等）。除非我把鼠标悬停在任何东西上并看到工具提示，否则我很难理解我是在自己的飞船上，还是在我已对接的飞船/空间站上，等等。  

这可能是有意为之，也许在游戏中花更多时间后，我会更熟悉格子的形状/颜色，从而更好地理解我在看什么。

On the surface, this game appears to have a ton of content and mechanics to keep you engaged. As you dive in, you find a visual monstrosity that has so much noise its chaotic to sift through it all and navigate your way through the game. 

The choice for art design, blurry low grade pixel textures - disappointing. I get that games that choose graphical quality usually suffer from low gameplay mechanics or features that make the game engaging and increase replayability value. 

Artwork aside - the game is painfully difficult to learn, you'll be reliant on youtube tutorials just to get a grasp and by the time you do you'll have burnt through the 2 hours steam refund window - so tread carefully.

items.text:
I wish there were a sideways thumb for this one.

If you really like the idea of space survival, exploration, trading, etc.  this is (on paper) a really awesome gem of a game.  Sincerely.  The interface is rough but serviceable once you learn the game.   Some of the mini games lke docking and exploration are IMO a lot of fun.  

However, I think i've found the first game in my life that the graphics were too low fidelity to enjoy the game.  I still actively play games from an Atari 800 computer (1979) and Commodore Amiga (1985), but my eyes genuinely have no idea what's on screen when I'm walking around stations or other ships.   It's a little extra jarring because some things (the player sprite, and menus / docking / 'books', etc) are significantly smoother and higher quality - so the asthetic change to the main game itself feels very off.  

The only thing I can think is that I raised the filter setting in graphics to maximum and maybe it made things worse.. but on my PC the game looked significantly worse than Rimworld which made it too hard to distinguish thingso n screen.  

 I wish the devs well on this game - it's definitely got a lot good going for it, especially heart and soul.
items.text_zh:
我希望这个能有个横向的拇指图标。

如果你真的喜欢太空生存、探索、贸易之类的概念，那么（理论上）这真是一款超棒的游戏瑰宝。真心话。界面很粗糙，但一旦你学会了游戏就还算能用。有些小游戏，比如对接和探索，我个人觉得非常有趣。

然而，我想我找到了我人生中第一款因为画质太低劣而让我无法享受的游戏。我至今还在积极玩雅达利800电脑（1979年）和康懋达Amiga（1985年）上的游戏，但当我在空间站或其他飞船里走动时，我的眼睛真的完全不知道屏幕上是什么东西。这有点格外刺眼，因为有些东西（玩家精灵图，以及菜单/对接/'书籍'等）明显更平滑、质量更高——所以主游戏本身的美术风格变化让人感觉非常不对劲。

我唯一能想到的是，我把图形设置里的滤镜调到了最高，也许这让情况更糟了……但在我的电脑上，这游戏看起来明显比《环世界》还差，导致屏幕上的东西太难分辨了。

我祝开发者们在这款游戏上一切顺利——它绝对有很多优点，尤其是用心和灵魂。

items.text:
I really WANT to like this game. The concept is neat, the depth is really cool, but it's being desperately held back by an EXTREMELY un-intuitive interface and UI. The skeuomorphic way you fly your ship is really neat, but the controls are deliberately obtuse and complicated and it makes it a nightmare to try and get into for new players.

This is on top of social interaction and character moodlets offering little to no information about what they actually do either. The top-down perspective also obscures what the hell you're looking at, which can be a real pain if you're trying to tell a battery charger from the O2 pressure alarm from a power switch from- You get the idea.

The game is for the truly hardcore ONLY and I have a serious case of buyer's regret since I tried to stick with it well past the return time-limit and make it work for me, only to discover that by looking too hard at the mystery meat in my space food, I'd introduced some lovecraftian abomination to my game that makes salvaging wrecks even HARDER. No thanks.

items.text:
[h1]Not recommended[/h1]
[h2]Decent spaceflight component, but ground game is weak and worsened by abysmal documentation. Early access so may improve, but needs work and is in rough shape as of September 2024.[/h2]

This is a game I dearly wanted to like. Despite having problems with Neo Scavenger years back to the point where I put it aside and have yet to pick it back up, I bought this game (thankfully on sale) because it looked good.
It might be good. Unfortunately, there's no way to really tell.

[h2]It aims for the stars...[/h2]
This game aims high. It wants to be a highly detailed simulation (excellent) of spaceflight and salvage (even better) and gives you the opportunity to not just buy but customize and even build ships (now we're talking). 

[h3]Great spaceflight component [/h3]
The spaceflight is magnificent, with strong overtones of Apollo and Space Shuttle controls and mechanics but suitably sci-fi. It feels [i]real[/i], and that's a rarity in a casual, non-simulation title. It's suitably gritty and requires patience and precision, and it doesn't really lend itself to being incautious - but you have the freedom to be if you so choose.

[h2]...and misses in almost every way.[/h2]
Unfortunately, that's where the praise is going to end because the game as it stands is barely playable for several reasons. 
[h3]Zero documentation [/h3]
First of all, there's no documentation. No, I don't count a half-assembled wiki full of things the average player can intuit as documentation, and zero points for having a Discord. The "player manual" is five pages and almost all of them are useless. There's a tutorial, but although it gives you tasks to complete it [i]explains[/i] very little, leaving you to learn everything by trial and error. Beginner area? None, you're in the deep end from the start. Training period, guidance, anything of the sort? Just the bare-bones tutorial. (Great, I've created a zone out of a patch of random floor... why did I do that?) So you're left to figure out this detailed game on your own. There are fan-made guides on Steam that are doing a better job as manuals for this game than the developers are providing. Not good.
[h3]Weak ground game, unbelievably flawed task execution [/h3]
As good as the spaceflight is, that's how bad things are once you're on the ground. The UI is, to be polite, a wreck. It's overcomplicated and under-designed. In the tutorial, you're shown how to repair something. Okay, good. But applying that lesson to a broken pump I took off of my first derelict, my character proceded to [i]walk out an airlock into hard vacuum without a helmet on.[/i] Why? Because he needed mechanical parts and went to get them. Automatically. In space. Without a helmet. Quickly steered him back inside only for him to... [i]do it again.[/i]. Because he has to be manually told to cancel all of his tasks or he's going to keep trying to go back to auto the moment your manual inputs are done. So, yeah, not the best design and it really doesn't get better. Want to open up a floor storage bin? Click on it... and get the controls for a pump instead. Turns out you have to keep right-clicking to cycle items on (or near) that tile. Would've been helpful if that'd been covered in the tutorial. Too dark to see? Turn on your worklight. It's still too dark. Why? Because the light needs to be held, not clipped to your suit. I have a worklight I use all the time. You clip it to your belt and it lights up your work area. This is lost technology in the future.
[h3]No explanations for critical gameplay components [/h3]
Many things are alluded to but never explained or in any way apparent. Got hit with a $15,000 fine for illegal salvage, ending my game before it really started because I was already in debt from my ship and couldn't pay for fuel or fees. I know you can buy a permit to salvage legally but I've yet to find [i]where or how[/i]. Went to the wiki to find out, only to be told what a permit is (I knew that much). Bad documentation strikes again. There's combat in the game, but you're not told what's involved, there's no tutorial on those mechanics at all, and the UI is as opaque for those tasks as it is for every other, so good luck. When I got mugged, I kept tackling and whacking him with a hacksaw (because punching him wasn't doing a thing) until he finally agreed to surrender... and two minutes later he died, which is expected when you beat someone with a hacksaw in space, but was there a better way? Maybe? No way to know. 
[h3]Weak graphics for walking section [/h3]
And this is a [i]very[/i] minor gripe because I generally don't really care about graphics compared to gameplay, but the ground-game graphics are so atrocious they deserve mention. They wouldn't have flown in the late 1990s, let alone the 2020s. This isn't a retro pixel style. It's just plain bad. 

[h2]The Bottom Line[/h2]
This is a game that [i]should[/i] be at least good if not outstanding, and maybe with time and some more work it will be. I really do hope so. But for right now, the obtuse, clunky UI design and lack of meaningful documentation or tooltips means that playing it is more frustrating than fulfilling. This is a thumbs-down I really feel bad about because there's a lot of promise here and it's clear there's passion behind its development, but until some of the problems are fixed and the game goes through some more revisions, it's just not there yet.
items.text_zh:
[h1]不推荐[/h1]
[h2]太空飞行部分尚可，但地面玩法薄弱，且因糟糕透顶的文档而雪上加霜。抢先体验版，所以可能会改进，但需要打磨，截至2024年9月仍处于粗糙状态。[/h2]

这是一款我非常想喜欢的游戏。尽管多年前玩《Neo Scavenger》时遇到问题，以至于我把它搁置一旁至今未再拾起，我还是买了这款游戏（幸好是在打折时），因为它看起来不错。
它可能确实不错。不幸的是，根本无法真正判断。

[h2]它志在星辰……[/h2]
这款游戏目标远大。它想成为一款高度精细的太空飞行与打捞模拟（很棒），甚至更好，并且让你不仅能够购买，还能定制甚至建造飞船（这才像话）。

[h3]出色的太空飞行部分[/h3]
太空飞行非常壮观，带有强烈的阿波罗和航天飞机操控与机制的色彩，但又恰如其分地科幻。它感觉[i]真实[/i]，这在休闲、非模拟类游戏中实属罕见。它恰如其分地粗粝，需要耐心和精确，并不真正适合鲁莽行事——但如果你愿意，你有自由去鲁莽。

[h2]……却几乎在各方面都失手了。[/h2]
不幸的是，赞美到此为止，因为就目前而言，这款游戏由于几个原因几乎无法游玩。
[h3]零文档[/h3]
首先，没有文档。不，我不把那种拼凑了一半、满是普通玩家都能凭直觉猜到的东西的wiki算作文档，有Discord也一分不值。“玩家手册”只有五页，而且几乎全是没用的。有个教程，但尽管它给你任务去完成，它[i]解释[/i]的东西却极少，让你只能通过反复试错来学习一切。新手区？没有，你从一开始就身处深水区。训练期、引导、任何类似的东西？只有那个骨瘦如柴的教程。（太好了，我用一块随机地板创建了一个区域……我为什么要那样做？）所以你只能靠自己摸索这款细节丰富的游戏。Steam上有玩家自制的指南，作为这款游戏的手册，它们比开发者提供的做得更好。不妙。
[h3]薄弱的地面玩法，难以置信地有缺陷的任务执行[/h3]
太空飞行有多好，一旦你到了地面上，事情就有多糟。UI，说得客气点，就是一塌糊涂。它过度复杂且设计不足。在教程中，你被展示了如何修理某样东西。好，不错。但当我把这一课应用到我从第一艘废弃飞船上拆下来的一个坏泵上时，我的角色竟然[i]没戴头盔就走出了气闸，进入了硬真空。[/i]为什么？因为他需要机械零件，就去拿了。自动地。在太空里。没戴头盔。我赶紧把他引回舱内，结果他又……[i]做了一次。[/i]因为他必须被手动告知取消所有任务，否则一旦你的手动输入结束，他就会一直试图回到自动模式。所以，是的，不是最好的设计，而且真的没有变好。想打开一个地板储物箱？点击它……结果却得到了一个泵的控制界面。原来你必须不断右键点击来循环切换那个格子（或附近）上的物品。如果教程里讲过这个就好了。太黑看不见？打开你的工作灯。还是太黑。为什么？因为灯需要手持，而不是夹在你的宇航服上。我有一盏一直用的工作灯。你把它夹在腰带上，它就能照亮你的工作区域。这在未来是失落的技术。
[h3]对关键玩法组件毫无解释[/h3]
许多东西被暗示，但从未被解释，或以任何方式显而易见。因为非法打捞被罚了15,000美元，游戏还没真正开始就结束了，因为我已经因飞船而负债，付不起燃料费或费用。我知道你可以购买许可证来合法打捞，但我还没找到[i]在哪里或如何[/i]购买。去wiki查，结果只告诉我许可证是什么（这我早就知道）。糟糕的文档再次作祟。游戏里有战斗，但没人告诉你涉及什么，完全没有关于这些机制的教程，而且UI对这些任务和其他所有任务一样晦涩难懂，所以祝你好运。当我被抢劫时，我一直擒抱并用钢锯猛击他（因为用拳头打他毫无作用），直到他终于同意投降……两分钟后他死了，在太空里用钢锯把人打成这样是意料之中的，但有更好的办法吗？也许有？无从得知。
[h3]步行部分的画面很差[/h3]
这是一个[i]非常[/i]小的抱怨，因为与玩法相比，我通常不太在乎画面，但地面玩法的画面实在太糟糕了，值得一提。它们在20世纪90年代末都拿不出手，更别说2020年代了。这不是复古像素风格。就是纯粹的差。

[h2]底线[/h2]
这是一款[i]本应[/i]至少不错、甚至出色的游戏，也许随着时间和更多打磨，它会变得出色。我真的希望如此。但就目前而言，晦涩、笨拙的UI设计以及缺乏有意义的文档或工具提示，意味着玩它比满足更令人沮丧。这个差评我真的给得很难受，因为这里有很多潜力，而且其开发背后显然有热情，但在一些问题得到修复、游戏经过更多修订之前，它就是还没达到那个水平。
未来的科技。
[h3]对关键玩法组件毫无解释[/h3]
许多东西被暗示，却从未被解释，也以任何方式都看不出来。因为非法打捞被罚了15,000美元，我的游戏还没真正开始就结束了，因为我已经因为飞船而负债，付不起燃料费或各种费用。我知道你可以买许可证来合法打捞，但我至今还没找到[i]在哪里或怎么买[/i]。去wiki查，结果只被告知许可证是什么（这我早就知道了）。糟糕的文档又一次发威。游戏里有战斗，但没人告诉你涉及什么，完全没有关于这些机制的教程，而且UI对这些任务来说和其他一切一样晦涩难懂，所以祝你好运。当我被抢劫时，我不断擒抱他并用钢锯猛砸他（因为用拳头打他根本没用），直到他终于同意投降……两分钟后他死了，在太空里用钢锯把人打成这样，这也在意料之中，但有没有更好的办法？也许有？无从得知。
[h3]步行部分画面孱弱[/h3]
这是一个[i]非常[/i]小的抱怨，因为比起玩法，我一般真的不太在乎画面，但地面游戏的画面实在太糟糕了，值得一提。这种画面在1990年代末都拿不出手，更别说2020年代了。这不是复古像素风格。就是单纯的烂。

[h2]总结[/h2]
这是一款[i]本应[/i]至少不错、甚至出色的游戏，也许随着时间和更多打磨，它会变得如此。我真的希望如此。但就目前而言，晦涩、笨拙的UI设计，以及缺乏有意义的文档或提示，意味着玩它比满足更令人沮丧。这是一个我真的很遗憾给出的差评，因为这里有很多潜力，而且很明显其开发背后有热情，但在一些问题被修复、游戏经过更多修订之前，它就是还不行。

There are some very special design elements in this game, that sometimes at first can seem clunky, but collectively they create a very immersive sandbox of mechanics. The direct world interface and the feeling of being small in space create a level of immersion that very few games have ever given me.

If I could change one thing, it's the resolution of the world tile map. The resolution of individual tiles in ships and stations is too small and doesn't read well enough for the detail of the contents. I really like the pixel art style though, but the current tile map resolution just doesn't feedback enough visual information to the player.

I am extremely interested in following this game, and look forward to seeing where it goes!


UPDATE:
This game has grown into my absolute favourite space experience. There are very few games on Steam that can truly say they have something unique and special, but this is one of them.

*I* love this game. You may not.
It has a very unique art style, and combines Space Station 13, with the Expanse and Hard Space Shipbreaker. 
The visuals can be confusing, the tutorial hints are often vague or entirely absent, it's still very early Access, with some bugs. That being said, it has a decent gameplay loop, pretty good emergent gameplay for being singleplayer, and an interesting, if familiar world. Most of the UI is skeumorphic.

I love this game.
I do recommend this game and I have recommended this game to friends and family.
The graphics are tough at first but after a while I am able to distinguish between a bin, vent and a door.
The learning curve is steep but satisfying when you get to the top(don’t worry there are other curves to climb after the first). If it get too difficult then there is a great workshop community ready to offer aid and advice on most topics.
Plus read the books in game and the help file.
I rate this game. It is not for everyone, if you prefer the console era of game play where you are hand held, constantly praised and never die then this game wont be for you, try No Man’s Sky.
It is in early access and yes it does have a few wrinkles to be ironed out, but I’m enjoying the journey.

Don't let my play time fool you, I have been on and off with this game but I think I have finally given up on it after a mildly enjoyable but equally frustrating playthrough. The triggering incident? A hauler ship hit me at ramming speed for no reason at all while I was working on a derelict ship . There was nothing I could do about it and I died from internal bleeding minutes after. Now you can argue that kind of behaviour can be patched out but this game has issues that goes beyond that. In no particular order:

* Awful graphics: I don't mind simple graphics, I don't mind indie games but when the graphics are so ugly and cluttered that they impede in your understanding of what's going on it becomes a problem. I shouldn't have to read things and click through things to see there is a big hole in the ship yet that's what you have to do in this game. It's difficult to read and recognize items at a glance and what you see doesn't always correspond to game mechanics.
* Awful interface: Now, look I played NEO Scavenger alright. I love that game but it had the most horrific GUI I have ever seen modern video game. This game's GUI is a bit more sophisticated than that but it still suffers from the same problems. You have to click through things multiple times to give simple commands and there is an obtuse choices menu you have to scroll through for everything. Building or uninstalling things are a pain. I often find myself struggling with the game to tell it to do what I want and that's never a good sign.
* Finicky, useless dialog system that suffers from the same interface problems with no immersive qualities and mostly about filling out some bars. Fun!
* Long-standing bugs and issues that doesn't seem to get fixed. Were you uninstalling something mounted to a wall and it had no nearby empty space to drop? Too bad, now it's on the other side of the wall and in space for some reason and it's a huge pain to get it. Did I mention the interface is frustrating?

So on and so forth. The reason why ı stayed with this game for so long is because I really liked No Scavenger and I was on board with the premise, but it seems to have all the flaws of that game except they are compounded even further because of its ambitious scope.

别让我的游戏时长骗了你，我断断续续地玩这款游戏，但在经历了一次有点愉快但同样令人沮丧的通关后，我想我终于放弃它了。触发事件？一艘运输船在我修理一艘废弃飞船时，毫无理由地以撞击速度撞向我。我对此无能为力，几分钟后我因内出血而死。现在你可以争辩说这种行为可以通过补丁修复，但这款游戏的问题远不止于此。不分先后：

* 糟糕的画面：我不介意简单的画面，我不介意独立游戏，但当画面如此丑陋和杂乱，以至于妨碍你理解正在发生的事情时，这就成了问题。我不应该为了看到船上有个大洞而不得不阅读东西并点击浏览，但这就是你在这款游戏中必须做的。很难一眼读懂和识别物品，而且你看到的东西并不总是与游戏机制相符。
* 糟糕的界面：听着，我玩过《NEO Scavenger》好吧。我喜欢那款游戏，但它有着我在现代电子游戏中见过的最可怕的图形用户界面。这款游戏的图形用户界面比那个稍微精致一些，但它仍然有同样的问题。你必须多次点击浏览才能给出简单的命令，而且有一个晦涩难懂的选择菜单，你必须为所有事情滚动浏览。建造或卸载东西很痛苦。我经常发现自己与游戏搏斗，想告诉它做我想做的事，这从来都不是好兆头。
* 挑剔、无用的对话系统，有着同样的界面问题，没有沉浸感，主要是填充一些进度条。真有趣！
* 长期存在的错误和问题似乎没有得到修复。你在卸载安装在墙上的东西，而附近没有空位可以掉落？太糟糕了，现在它不知为何到了墙的另一边，在太空中，要拿到它非常痛苦。我提到界面令人沮丧了吗？

诸如此类。我之所以坚持玩这款游戏这么久，是因为我真的很喜欢《No Scavenger》，我也认同它的设定，但它似乎有那款游戏的所有缺陷，只是由于其雄心勃勃的范围而进一步加剧了。

Gave me a migraine just trying to figure out what I was looking at. A horrible 40 minutes which is a shame because the premise is fantastic.

ОБНОВЛЯЮ ОБЗОР ВРЕМЯ-ОТ ВРЕМЕНИ

Пока что не стоит ее покупать.
Да разраб инди, да круто выглядят пиксели. 
Однако, игра слишком ломаная чтобы получать от нее удовольствие без казусов.
Ближе к технодемке нежели полноценной игре.

23/08/2024 
Тестовая версия 0.14

Стало плавнее, управление все такое же не удобное и плохо продуманное. Визуально трудно отличать элементы окружения но со временем плюс-минус понимаешь. У е б и щно сделано общение с НПЦ, вы ничего не поймете, все общение это социальный бой. Если вам приходит что какой-то там чел хочет встретиться - просто удаляйте задание, там ничего нет, это просто мусорный вброс похожий на квест.
Истории, задачи или хоть намеков что у куда можно поехать и сделать нет и это совсем не интуитивно.

Оценка все еще минус. Радует что хоть не закинуто.

04.03.2025
Версия 0.14.что-то что-то (последняя бета)

Багов стало меньше, их НЕ МАЛО, но меньше.
Пройдемся по БАЗЕ:
1. Система команды все так же сосет. Брать себе кента - как родить второго ребенка. Если сначала тебе нужно было МИКРОМЕНЕДЖИТЬ целого персонажа, теперь тебе надо делать дополнительные 40 кликов каждый раз когда тебе нужно что-то сделать. Вместе с тем, что приказы работают НЕВЕРОЯТНО КРИВО и большую часть времени перс будет стоять смотреть в пол, потому-что он отказывается верить что запчасть существует только потому-что она за дверью это классика. Все это формирует гигадрочь, серьезно, у вас руки устанут. А теперь представьте - вам надо играть так минимум 8 часов просто чтобы покинуть стартовую локацию. Иными словами, нужно 8 часов заниматься невероятно большим количеством менеджмента карманов, кукл(персов), места, 12 показателями хотбара для каждого персонажа, оплатой, бумажками используя ужасно дырявый инструментарий для геймплея - ТОЛЬКО ЧТОБЫ ПОТРОГАТЬ ИГРУ ВНЕ СТАРТОВОЙ ЛОКИ, БУКВАЛЬНО ПОЕХАТЬ КРЫШЕЙ НАДО ЧТОБЫ ДОБРАТЬСЯ ДО КОНТЕНТА.


18/09/25
v0.14.5.5
Радует что хотя-бы не заброшенный проект.
Многие проблемы описанные выше все еще актуальны.
По фактам:
-Добавили QOL фичи, меньше ебки с инвентарем, стало удобнее перемещать вещи.
-Очень понравилась новая фича с картриджами для ПДА которая открывает новые инструменты и сканеры. Очень полезная штука. (НО!!!! Это наверное лучший способ заработка в начале - искать корабли с жмурами, снимать ПДА и продавать из них файлы и картриджи.)
- Диалоги стали НЕМНОГО приятнее в пользовании.
-Очень хороший игровой гайдбук, приятный на вид, смешной по тексту.
- До контента все так же трудно хоть как-то добраться. Потратив 6 часов в новой версии, все что я опять же смог ощутить это однобразный гринд. Игра позиционирует себя как песочница, но МАКСИМАЛЬНО отказывается ей быть - свобода действий только на словах, ВСЕ упирается в то, что нужно как придурок резать реакторы и надеяться что их скупает барыга. 

Отсюда мои главные притензии и проблемы на данный момент:
- Почему нет опций для начала в других сценариях? Почему нельзя выбрать начальную систему?
- Где хоть какие-то альтернативные пути развития и геймплея, если игра песочница?
-Почему разраб делает те же ошибки в принятии геймплейных решений, что и в Neo Scavanger, после всех слов критики от сообщества?
- Когда игра получит хоть какой-то сюжет, интересные диалоги, запоминающихся персонажей? ДА BLYAT ШАРМА ИГРЕ НЕ ХВАТАЕТ. ЭТО СИМУЛЯТОР КОТОРЫЙ НЕ ХОЧЕТ ЧТОБЫ ИМ ПОЛЬЗОВАЛИСЬ ХОТЬ КАК-ТО КРОМЕ САМОГО СКУЧНОГО, ОДНООБРАЗНОГО И БЛЕКЛОГО СПОСОБА.

Пока что вывод такой - это не игра, это тупо симулятор, причем среднего качества. Пока разраб не выпьет глицинчика и не переосознает, что то, что он делает не побуждает с этим взаимодействовать. Люди напилили кучу модов, которые в разы лучше и осознаннее чем то, что выдает разраб. Только на них и держится хоть какая-то поддержка игры. Боюсь, она станет очередным инди долгостроем, где разрабы не слышат свое же коммьюнити, но упорно тратят свое время и ресурсы поддержавших их игроков, но то, что им и не нужно. Увы

我会时不时更新这篇评测

目前还不值得买。
没错，开发者是独立开发者，没错，像素看起来很棒。
然而，游戏太破碎了，没法在没有各种意外状况的情况下从中获得乐趣。
更像是技术演示，而不是一款完整的游戏。

2024年8月23日
测试版本 0.14

变得更流畅了，操作还是那么不方便，设计得也很糟糕。视觉上很难区分环境元素，但时间久了多多少少能看懂。和NPC的交流做得烂得一塌糊涂，你什么都搞不明白，所有交流都是一场社交战斗。如果有人给你发消息说某个家伙想见面——直接删掉任务，那里什么都没有，这只是一个像任务一样的垃圾投放。
没有故事、任务，甚至连暗示你能去哪里、做什么的提示都没有，而且这一点完全不直观。

评分仍然是负分。令人欣慰的是至少没被弃坑。

2025年3月4日
版本 0.14.某某某某（最后一个测试版）

Bug变少了，它们并不少，但变少了。
来说说基础部分：
1. 队伍系统还是一样烂。收个兄弟就像生第二个孩子。如果以前你需要微观管理一整个角色，现在每次你需要做点什么的时候，都得额外点40下。再加上命令运行得难以置信地歪，大部分时间角色会站在那里盯着地板，因为他拒绝相信一个零件存在，仅仅因为它在一扇门后面，这是经典操作。这一切构成了巨大的折磨，说真的，你的手会累。现在想象一下——你至少得这样玩8个小时，仅仅是为了离开起始地点。换句话说，你需要花8个小时进行数量惊人的口袋管理、人偶（角色）管理、空间管理、每个角色12个快捷栏指标、付款、文书工作，使用极其漏洞百出的游戏工具——仅仅是为了在起始锁定区域之外摸到游戏，字面意义上得发疯才能接触到内容。


2025年9月18日
v0.14.5.5
令人欣慰的是至少项目没被弃坑。
上面描述的许多问题仍然存在。
说事实：
-加入了QOL功能，背包操作没那么操蛋了，移动物品变得更方便。
-非常喜欢PDA卡带的新功能，它解锁了新的工具和扫描仪。非常有用的东西。（但是！！！！这大概是前期最好的赚钱方式——找有尸体的船，取下PDA，卖掉里面的文件和卡带。）
- 对话用起来稍微舒服了一点。
-非常好的游戏指南书，外观讨喜，文字搞笑。
- 内容还是那么难以接触到。在新版本里花了6个小时，我再次能感受到的只有单调的刷。游戏把自己定位成沙盒，却最大限度地拒绝成为沙盒——行动自由只停留在口头上，一切都卡在你得像傻子一样切反应堆，然后指望有贩子收购它们。

因此，我目前的主要不满和问题如下：
- 为什么没有在其他场景中开始的选项？为什么不能选择起始星系？
- 如果游戏是沙盒，那至少一些替代的发展路径和玩法在哪里？
- 为什么开发者在游戏玩法决策上犯着和Neo Scavenger一样的错误，在社区说了那么多批评之后？
- 游戏什么时候才能有哪怕一点剧情、有趣的对话、令人难忘的角色？是的，BLYAT，游戏缺少魅力。这是一个模拟器，它不想让人们以任何方式使用它，除了最无聊、最单调、最黯淡的方式。

目前的结论是这样的——这不是游戏，这纯粹是个模拟器，而且是中等质量的。只要开发者不喝点甘氨酸、不重新意识到，他所做的东西并不能促使人们与之互动。人们做了一大堆模组，比开发者做出来的东西好上数倍、也更有意识。游戏仅存的一点支持就靠它们撑着。我担心它会变成又一个独立长期项目，开发者听不到自己社区的声音，却顽固地花费自己的时间和支持他们的玩家的资源，去做他们根本不需要的东西。唉

items.text:
I am a bit torn on whether to give a thumbs up or down. 
When it comes to long-term potential or atmosphere, that's a clear thumbs-up. This is a labor of love that already is something I want to play, and it can grow into something outstanding in the field of "life in space" sims.

So why do I give a thumbs-down?
Not necessarily because the UI choices are "interesting" at times. One can learn the control scheme, as clumsy as they sometimes might come across.
It's an Early Access title, so nobody in their right mind would (should) expect a polished game without bugs or problems.

I like the "everything manual" approach for the most part. It makes me feel like I'm actually piloting a ship.

What my aging eyes can't cope with is the dev's choice of going ultra-low resolution with the "action" graphics.
As long as you're inside your ship, working off the control panels, everything is clear, crisp and readable.
The map is low-res, but fitting the theme and not too bad on the eyes.
Once you switch to the "run around the ship/station"-mode of the game, it's a visual quality whiplash.

Although I understand what the devs are going for, the pixelated graphics are incredibly hard on my eyes. I have no idea what I'm looking at most of the time, because there's a mishmash of colored pixels on screen that don't resemble anything. I can't make out what's what and have to point my mouse at everything that I want to identify. It gets even worse on derelict ships, where even the shapes of things might appear broken up, so for me, it looks like I'm steering my (always recognizable) character over a screen of graphical glitches, not through a spaceship in disrepair.

That's my main point why I am giving it thumbs-down. Your mileage may vary greatly from mine and maybe your eyes can make out everything fine. Please try this game out if space-life is your thing.

I'll certainly come back to this from time to time, because it largely is what I want in a space game, but it's a pity my eyes prevent me from really enjoying it wholeheartedly.
items.text_zh:
我有点纠结该给好评还是差评。
说到长期潜力或氛围，那绝对是好评。这是一份倾注了热爱的作品，已经是我想要玩的东西，而且它有可能在“太空生活”模拟游戏领域成长为出类拔萃的作品。

那我为什么给差评？
不一定是因为UI选择有时显得“有趣”。控制方案是可以学会的，尽管有时可能显得笨拙。
这是一款抢先体验作品，所以任何头脑正常的人都不会（也不应该）期待一款没有bug或问题的打磨完善的游戏。

我大体上喜欢“一切手动”的做法。这让我感觉自己真的在驾驶一艘飞船。

我那上了年纪的眼睛无法忍受的，是开发者选择让“动作”画面采用超低分辨率。
只要你在飞船内部，操作控制面板，一切都清晰、锐利、可读。
地图是低分辨率的，但符合主题，看着也不算太糟。
一旦你切换到游戏里“在飞船/空间站里跑来跑去”的模式，视觉质量就来了个急转弯。

虽然我理解开发者想要追求什么，但那些像素化画面对我的眼睛来说极其难受。大多数时候我根本不知道自己在看什么，因为屏幕上是一堆乱七八糟的彩色像素，什么都不像。我分辨不出什么是什么，只能把鼠标指向每一个我想辨认的东西。在废弃飞船上情况更糟，那里连物体的形状都可能显得支离破碎，所以对我来说，看起来就像是我在操控我的（总是能认出来的）角色穿过一屏图形故障，而不是穿过一艘破败的飞船。

这就是我给差评的主要原因。你的体验可能和我的大不相同，也许你的眼睛能把这些都看得清清楚楚。如果太空生活是你的菜，请试试这款游戏。

我肯定会时不时再回来玩，因为它在很大程度上正是我想在太空游戏里得到的东西，但遗憾的是，我的眼睛让我无法真正全心全意地享受它。

items.text: Oyuna girip 15 dakika oynamam yetti beğenip beğenmeyeceğimi anlayabilmek için. Geliştiricilerin bundan önce yapmış olduğu Neo Scavenger oyununu ayıla bayıla oynamış birisi olarak bu oyun içinde aynı beklentilere sahiptim fakat genel atmosfer, arayüz ve oyunun genel görselliği inanılmaz itici. Sanki bir mobil oyunu emulator ile oynuyormuşum gibi hissettim. items.text:
Try this game.  You may love it.  I love almost everything about this game but I almost never play it. Why?  There is one major reason that hinders an otherwise awesome game;  it's very hard to visually distinguish anything visually.  I played B&W Sim City for years, as well as Star Raiders back in the early 80s.  I have zero problem with retro graphics.  However, the current graphics make it tough to discern anything.  They don't need to be "better".  They simply need to be clearer.  Think of how easy it was to discern each tile in the first Sim City, which included different states for each tile.  It can be done in a retro and simple way.  This is the only obstacle to me getting into this game a lot more.  

Another minor request would be more freedom (the more, the better) in the character creation, but I assume that will happen.  Deeper relationships between you and NPCs could make the game even more interesting, and I know that is coming.  

One suggestion (and this is a stretch) would be to consider allowing the player to "settle down" at some point, perhaps as a type of end game.  Allowing us to purchase and partially customize property on some asteroid, moon, or even a major planet (if our bodies could handle the gravity) could give an optional direction to our toils out in the expanse. 

I dearly love everything else. There is a legendary and pretty unique game here, and I've been playing space games since the literal dawn of space games.  I give a negative review only in light of the visual barriers I personally find obstructive.

This game is WAY freaking cool. Its also one of the only games ive ever wanted multiplayer.
But damn its buggy. like palmetto season, like an Egyptian curse, ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ locust swarms.

Creating vibes in a video game is difficult, but damn i do feel like im an Ostranuat with this game...
This game is super hard sci-fi and heavy in detail. I was surprised at how quickly i picked everything up, given its complexity i thought i was going to have a harder time tbh, but its all fairly intuitive. Hardest thing for me is telling one pixel from another... Objects can stack which just blends it all together, making a mess of the screen.

Also its ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ hard... I mean like, you can spend several hours getting your ♥♥♥♥ together to simply get stuck. I still dont really know how to play the game tbh.
Given all the game breaking bugs, I would heavily suggest the devs make custom difficulties available, ranging from needs, fines to fuel and a better tutorial. Also cheats, while i agree they ruin games, but ending a run because of bugs is even worse. I would also love to see more accessibility options. Like color blindness, and more and better overlays.
There were several notable bugs, some game breaking.
Eg. when you save your game, you have no idea at what point its saved. So you can loose 10 mins of game play when you reload the game.
There was a power glitch when i ran unbuilt cable, it still connected the power. The game thought those cables existed when they were not built yet.
I tried to repair a power generator, added all components but it would not repair past 99.99%.
Sometimes when uninstalling something, the item will disapear. Which can be devastating.

If the devs clean up the bugs, this could easily be one of my favorite space games.

TL;DR: Refund / Ne pas acheter.

Au début, j'ai vu un jeu de simulation où on peut se balader dans son vaisseau, changer de vaisseau, gérer son inventaire, des traits qui rendent les persos différents... Ça avait l'air intéressant.


--- Récolte de données ---

Au lancement, le jeu demande un accès à Internet alors que c'est un jeu hors ligne. Déjà, ça sent la bonne télémétrie sans rien demander, ça part mal.


--- Langues ---

On peut changer le format des dates et l'unité de température dans les options, mais ça se limite à ça (d'ailleurs, pas de Fahrenheit, désolé les Ricains et les Canadiens).

Pas de choix de langue ni rien, le jeu est sortit y a 2 ans, mais faut croire que les devs n'ont pas voulu prendre 1 journée pour traduire le jeu dans 2/3 langues.

C'est un détail certes, mais dans un jeu ou 90 % du gameplay requiert de lire du texte, c'est dommage.


--- Création de personnage ---


Dès la création de perso ça commence déjà à sentir le pâté ; la création de perso est excessivement limitée.

C'est possible de choisir sa couleur de peau et son "pronom" pour être "non-binary", par contre impossible de choisir la couleur de ses cheveux ou de sa pilosité.

Ne vous y trompez pas, cette fausse inclusivité n'est là que pour cacher la misère, pour que les 2-3 plus manipulables se sentent moins frustrés d'avoir seulement peu de choix dans ce qui leur est proposé.

D'ailleurs, changer sa couleur de peau randomize le personnage, donc le faites pas en dernier, vous allez perdre les 4 pauvres options que vous avez choisies.


--- UI ---

Passons au plus gros point noir de ce jeu : l'UI.

L'UI est lamentable, à tel point que je crois pas avoir déja croisé un blasphème pareil dans mon expérience de joueur.

Les cases de l'inventaire sont minuscules et les menus sont tellement laids qu'ils pourraient être exposés dans des musées d'art contemporain.

Ces derniers ne sont au mieux pas ergonomiques, aux pires incompréhensibles.


--- Graphismes ---

Pour le 2d point noir de ce jeu, les graphismes. Étant habitué a dwarf fortress, aurora4x et moult autres jeux indés aux graphismes sommaires, je râle très rarement sur ce point en général.

Mais là, ce n'est pas possible, il faut en parler.

On ne comprend rien à ce qu'on a à l'écran, j'ai parfois presque l'impression que c'est des textures aléatoires. Je pense que les textures ont été faites en prenant une couleur unie et en ajoutant du bruit dessus.

--- Conclusion ---

Refund + passez votre chemin. 

On verra ce que ça donnera d'ici quelques années s'il n'est pas abandonné d'ici là.

TL;DR：退款 / Ne pas acheter。

一开始，我看到一个模拟游戏，你可以在自己的飞船里四处走动、更换飞船、管理自己的库存、还有让角色变得不同的特质……看起来挺有意思。


--- 数据收集 ---

启动时，这游戏明明是个离线游戏却要求联网。一开始就感觉是在未经请求的情况下搞那种典型的遥测，开局就不妙。


--- 语言 ---

可以在选项里更改日期格式和温度单位，但也就仅此而已（顺带一提，没有华氏度，抱歉了美国人和加拿大人）。

没有语言选择之类的，这游戏都出了2年了，但看来开发者连花1天时间把游戏翻译成2/3种语言都不愿意。

这确实是个细节，但在一个90%的玩法都需要阅读文本的游戏里，这很可惜。


--- 角色创建 ---


从角色创建开始就已经开始发臭了；角色创建极其有限。

可以选择肤色和“代词”来成为“非二元性别”，但无法选择头发或体毛的颜色。

别误会，这种虚假的包容只是为了掩盖糟糕的现状，让那2-3个更容易被操纵的人对自己在所提供的选项中只有很少选择这件事少一些挫败感。

另外，更改肤色会随机化角色，所以别最后才做，你会失去你选的那4个可怜选项。


--- UI ---

接下来谈谈这游戏最大的黑点：UI。

UI糟糕透顶，以至于我觉得在我的玩家经历中从没见过如此亵渎的东西。

库存格子小得可怜，菜单丑得简直可以拿去当代艺术博物馆展出。

这些菜单往好了说是不符合人体工学，往坏了说是让人无法理解。


--- 画面 ---

这游戏第二大黑点，画面。由于习惯了dwarf fortress、aurora4x以及许多其他画面简陋的独立游戏，我一般很少在这点上抱怨。

但这里，这不行，必须得说说。

屏幕上是什么根本看不懂，我有时几乎觉得那是随机纹理。我觉得这些纹理就是拿一种纯色然后往上面加噪点做出来的。

--- 结论 ---

退款 + 别碰。

看看几年后它会变成什么样吧，如果到那时它还没被放弃的话。

The short answer is no, not in its present state. The UI is clunky, the game play is unbalanced and it needs a good tutorial as very little is self-evident. Also, the graphics are real bad (which to be fair, I knew going into the purchase).

More details: [spoiler] Even after watching several videos on YouTube while on pause (a mistake on my part - as game playtime still accrues while paused and caused me to surpass my refund time limit of 2 hours) and playing all three ships, I still found it difficult. I either died or became delinquent on the ship's mortgage note. It's no wonder these ships become available. The previous hapless soul either dies or gets his ship repo-ed and they just present it to the next fool in line. Depending on your starting ship, you either die because your free (smallest) ship is too small (i.e. doesn't have enough oxygen and/or space to allow you to salvage long enough to get or carry enough items to cover the docking fees at the salvage base) or your bigger ship has too big of a mortgage payment and not enough time to salvage enough to pay it. Where's the fun in that?

Even using the auto-dock cheat feature to save oxygen and battery/fuel reserves, (for those like me who's poor vector piloting skills keep the flight times dangerously long), I still manage to fail. It's a bit too frustrating for me. So unless you have a lot of patience or the developer introduces some sort of level of difficulty settings (beyond just the ability to slow and speed up time), I'd avoid this game, as it does not take into account the diversity of playing skills that a purchaser of this game may have.

It would help the player to know how long an action would take and how much oxygen time the ship/suit has, so we know if attempting a particular action would cause us to die before completing the action. As it is now (If I am understanding this game correctly and have not overlooked something that a tutorial could have helped with), we have no idea (or estimate) of how long a trip takes nor how much time a particular actions takes. So' it's no wonder we fail. [/spoiler]

更多细节：[剧透] 即使在暂停时看了几个YouTube视频（这是我的失误——因为暂停时游戏时间仍在累积，导致我超过了两小时的退款时限），并且玩遍了全部三艘飞船，我仍然觉得很难。我要么死了，要么拖欠了飞船的抵押贷款。难怪这些飞船会变得可用。之前那个倒霉蛋要么死了，要么飞船被收回，然后他们就直接把它交给下一个排队的傻瓜。取决于你的起始飞船，你要么因为你的免费（最小）飞船太小而死（即没有足够的氧气和/或空间让你打捞足够长的时间，以获得或携带足够的物品来支付打捞基地的停靠费），要么你的较大飞船有太高的抵押贷款还款额，而没有足够的时间打捞足够的东西来支付它。这有什么乐趣可言？

即使使用自动停靠作弊功能来节省氧气和电池/燃料储备（对于像我这样糟糕的矢量驾驶技术使飞行时间危险地过长的人），我仍然设法失败。这对我来说有点太令人沮丧了。所以除非你有很大的耐心，或者开发者引入某种难度设置（不仅仅是能够减慢和加快时间的能力），否则我会避开这款游戏，因为它没有考虑到这款游戏的购买者可能拥有的多样化游戏技能。

如果玩家能知道一个动作需要多长时间，以及飞船/宇航服还有多少氧气时间，那会很有帮助，这样我们就知道尝试某个特定动作是否会导致我们在完成动作之前死亡。就目前而言（如果我正确理解这款游戏，并且没有忽略某个教程本可以帮助解决的问题），我们不知道（也无法估计）一次旅行需要多长时间，也不知道某个特定动作需要多长时间。所以，难怪我们会失败。[/剧透]

items.text:
[Edit after a few more hours into the game 16 Sept 2020]

It's an open/sandbox game where you start with a simple pod with a battery and barely enough energy to a scrapyard where you'll start salvaging broken ships to expand yours.

It kinda reminds me of Barotrauma for the idea of ship complexity but with the full liberty of creation and of Hellion, for the free roaming/exploration/salvaging/navigation, both games I love.
The idea is great and allows a lot of freedom in creating your very own ship.There are interesting game mechanisms for object placement, connections, air, temperature,  electricity and so on.There seems to be quite a fair amount of randomly generated narrative, for instance at the creation of your character. 
Some panels, like the docking or the reactor, are really nice and add a lot to the immersion, I love it.
Graphics are a very poor 3d but it's a style I don't mind actually.
Thanks to the few patches of the first days, I've been able to navigate a bit and dock to the first derelicts. 
Generated randomly between another rescue pod or a large spaceship, in a poor or rather ok state.

Now, onto the very bad parts.
Even though I should be tolerant with an early access game, it is difficultly playable and very grindy.
- All actions take a lot of time, (but you can accelerate time)
- Cursor location bugs, where you need to restart the game every so often.
- Docking procedure very unclear, I understood that one, you have to face the derelict with the tip of your ship even though your airlock is at the back... Once you know
- very harsh balance where you'll grind heavy objects and sell them to get a very necessary tool at the beginning
- also, not helping, most of the derelicts are so broken that you can't even enter them at the beginning
- swapping the batteries at the beginning is a chore and you'll end unlucky by finding no derelict with reactor to recharge them on
- very little progression/objective at the moment, but I'm sure it will be corrected.
- items that you lose for no good reason
- stuffs you can't remove
- some of the sounds in this game are also kinda horrific, like proximity alarms that will not shut down when docked
- some bugs are actually favorable like infinite O2
- lack of quick options to do stuffs like undocking
- pieces of the ship that are not repaired yet with no indication
- items that you cannot place on the floor where you want and you have to keep taking and dropping them until they are where you want
- Pressure, mass, temperatures, gravity that go haywire
- and some more deadlier bugs where your ship will basically crash and be destroyed for no good reason due to bugs in undocking for instance.
The list is quite long

So basically, it feels like a game with nice game mechanics but not polished, extremely buggy and configured to be grindy with high chances of death and it questions why I'm spending time in the game. It really needs to become more friendly to the player.
I'm sure the game could become something in the end but unless you want to support the developer, to be avoided for now.

I'll likely change my mind in future updates and review this frequently

That kinda reminds me of the state of disarray that was Space Engineers at the beginning.
items.text_zh:
[在游戏里多玩几个小时后于2020年9月16日编辑]

这是一款开放/沙盒游戏，你一开始只有一个带电池的简易舱，能量勉强够你到达一个废料场，在那里你将开始打捞破损的飞船来扩展你自己的飞船。

它让我有点想起《Barotrauma》，因为飞船复杂性的理念，但拥有完全的创造自由；也让我想起《Hellion》，因为自由漫游/探索/打捞/航行，这两款游戏我都喜欢。
这个想法很棒，允许你在创建自己飞船时拥有很大的自由。对于物体放置、连接、空气、温度、电力等，都有有趣的游戏机制。似乎有相当数量的随机生成的叙事，例如在你创建角色时。
有些面板，比如对接或反应堆，真的很好，大大增加了沉浸感，我很喜欢。
画面是非常糟糕的3D，但这其实是一种我不介意的风格。
多亏了最初几天的几个补丁，我已经能够稍微航行一下，并对接到最初的几艘废弃飞船。
它们是在另一个救援舱或一艘大型飞船之间随机生成的，状态很差或还算可以。

现在，来说说非常糟糕的部分。
尽管我应该对一款抢先体验游戏保持宽容，但它很难玩，而且非常肝。
- 所有动作都要花很多时间，（但你可以加速时间）
- 光标位置bug，你需要时不时重启游戏。
- 对接程序非常不清楚，我搞明白了那一个，你必须用你飞船的尖端面对废弃飞船，尽管你的气闸在后方……一旦你知道了
- 非常严苛的平衡，你一开始得肝沉重的物体并把它们卖掉，才能得到一个非常必要的工具
- 而且，更糟的是，大多数废弃飞船破损得太严重，一开始你甚至无法进入它们
- 一开始更换电池是件苦差事，而且你会很不走运地发现没有一艘废弃飞船有反应堆可以给它们充电
- 目前进展/目标非常少，但我相信这会被修正。
- 你会无缘无故失去的物品
- 你无法移除的东西
- 这款游戏里有些声音也有点可怕，比如接近警报在对接后不会关闭
- 有些bug实际上是有利的，比如无限氧气
- 缺少快速执行诸如解除对接之类操作的选项
- 飞船尚未修复的部分没有任何指示
- 你无法把物品放在地板上你想要的位置，你必须不停地拿起又放下，直到它们到了你想要的位置
- 压力、质量、温度、重力会失控
- 还有一些更致命的bug，比如由于解除对接时的bug，你的飞船基本上会无缘无故坠毁并被摧毁。
这个清单相当长

所以基本上，感觉像是一款游戏机制不错但未经打磨、bug极多，并且被配置成很肝、死亡几率很高的游戏，这让我质疑自己为什么要花时间在这游戏里。它真的需要对玩家更友好一些。
我相信这款游戏最终可能会有所成就，但除非你想支持开发者，否则目前还是避开为好。

在未来的更新中我可能会改变想法，并经常重新评测

这让我有点想起《Space Engineers》刚开始时那种混乱状态。

I'll keep an eye on the development of this game, but for now I can't recommend it.
